page: The OVHcloud d2-8 is a virtual server belonging to the Discovery family, utilizing KVM virtualization. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features an Intel Haswell processor with 4 shared vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 8.0 GB of system memory, which provides 2.0 GB of RAM per core, and is bundled with 50 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

In benchmark evaluations, the shared CPU allocation and older architecture position this server in the entry-level performance tier. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance ranks in the bottom 10% with a score of 917.98, while the multi-core CPU performance falls in the bottom 25% at 3730.94. Memory bandwidth tests show weak results in the bottom 25%, with read-only large block transfers reaching 35.67 GB/sec and write operations at 23.03 GB/sec. Passmark testing aligns with these findings, placing the overall CPU score, encryption, and physics capabilities in the lower percentiles.

Given its shared resource model and modest performance profile, the d2-8 offers a highly cost-efficient solution for workloads that do not require sustained high-performance computing. It is best suited for non-production environments, software development, basic web serving, and light database testing where resource density and budget optimization are primary considerations.
